lemmas.primary_translation: take responsibility for something or expose oneself to something unpleasant or difficult

definitions.text: påta seg avsvaret for noe eller utsette seg for noe ubehagelig eller vanskelig
definitions.translation: take responsibility for something or expose oneself to something unpleasant or difficult (lit. take the blow)

examples.no: lederen måtte ta støyten for den dårlige økonomien
examples.en: the manager had to take the blame for the poor economy
